root_cause.text: The amdgpu device cleanup path assumed every late-initialized IP block in `adev->ip_blocks` had a valid `version` pointer, so `amdgpu_device_set_cg_state()` and `amdgpu_device_set_pg_state()` dereferenced `ip_blocks[i].version` during teardown even after failed initialization left some unsupported HW blocks with `version == NULL`.
